_archive.purpose: Preserve the original VECTOR release-manifest concept as a historical design reference.
_archive.supersessionNote: This schema predates the current VECTOR FROZEN governance, versioning and dataset rules. It must not be used as the authoritative release contract for new VECTOR releases.
overholtSummary: The release channel model PREFLIGHT/RC/PRODUCTION predates the current develop -> Vercel Preview -> main -> Production workflow.
The schema models only a LIVE SCMDB dataset and does not model the parallel, strictly isolated LIVE/PTU runtime dataset contexts.
The schema has no explicit dataset revision/source revision model for same-build dataset refreshes.
The schema has no explicit Completeness Filter state for LIVE and PTU.
Extraction, normalization, validation, publishability and activation are not represented as separate pipeline stages.
The current canonical internal identifier Vector_{VersionNumber}_SC_{LIVEBuild} is not enforced as a required field.
Application releases and dataset-only activations are not modeled as separate manifest event types.
Current Git branch/Vercel environment governance is not represented.
Current MAJOR-release README documentation requirements are not represented.
Current migration/database gate evidence and build-triggered game-wipe references are not represented.
preservedConcepts: LIVE as the canonical Star Citizen release baseline
SCMDB as the release data authority/source
SCMDB dataset identity, export metadata and content hash
build metadata such as Next.js, Node and database schema
Production requiring a validated compatibility state
_archive.futureDirection: Use this file as the OG concept reference when designing VECTOR_RELEASE_SCHEMA_V2.json against the current FROZEN rules.
